# livery.yml reference

<!-- GENERATED by `livery schema --doc` from _extensions/engine/livery.schema.json; do not edit. -->

A livery's engine knobs, beside its _brand.yml (the colors, fonts and logos). Fractions are of the slide's height unless a key says width. A flavor (extends:) names only what differs from its parent.

Each file starts with the schema it is written for, and its first line lets an editor check it as you type:

```yaml
# yaml-language-server: $schema=../../_extensions/engine/livery.schema.json
schema: 1
name: mybrand
```

Value kinds: a *color* is a `_brand.yml` palette name or a `#RRGGBB` hex; a *role* is a role name (`roles` below); an *image* is a `_brand.yml` `logo.images` name; a *path* is relative to the livery; a *fraction* is of the slide's height unless the key says width. A key left out takes its default, or its parent's in a flavor.

### The top level

| key | type | default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `schema` | `1` |  | The schema this file is written for: 1. |
| `name` | string |  | The livery's name, as LIVERY= picks it. |
| `extends` | string or null |  | A parent livery beside this one: this livery wears everything of the parent's that it does not name itself. |
| `roles` | object |  | Which palette color plays each part of the slides. A value is a _brand.yml palette name or a #RRGGBB hex; primary, secondary, foreground and background default to _brand.yml's. |
| `blends` | object |  | Colors the engine blends from the roles, set outright. A value is a palette name or a hex. |
| `geometry` | object |  | The slides' furniture, in fractions of the slide. |
| `section` | object |  | Section slides. |
| `art` | object |  | Pictures and curves behind the fields. A path is relative to the livery. |
| `signoff` | object |  | A second lockup at the foot of every slide but feature and full ones. |
| `title` | object |  | The cover's composition. |
| `marks` | map |  | Which mark and sign-off each field wears, by the field's role: background (content slides; default logo.medium.light, signoff.light), primary (covers, sections, the closing; default the dark ones), any other role the primary's. |
| `compositions` | object |  | Overrides of the composed slides' boxes and colors, by slide; every slide takes the parts of compositions.<name> below. |
| `feature` | object |  | Feature (photo) slides. |
| `frametitle` | object |  | Content slides' titles. |
| `installed-fonts` | object |  | A proprietary face to prefer over the bundled stand-in where the machine has it: a family name (its four faces named the usual way) or {family, faces}. |
| `latex` | object |  | The LaTeX side. |
| `pptx` | object |  | The PowerPoint template. |
| `type` | object |  | Text sizes in points on the pptx.size canvas, whole or half points. A role left out is the engine's default (given here on 13.333 x 7.5 in) scaled to the canvas; subhead, table, code, caption and footnote also scale with the body. |
| `charts` | object |  | The chart colors: where a palette for plots comes from. With none of these, the engine generates one from the brand's colors that passes the dataviz checks. |

### `roles`

Which palette color plays each part of the slides. A value is a _brand.yml palette name or a #RRGGBB hex; primary, secondary, foreground and background default to _brand.yml's.

| key | type | default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `primary` | color |  | The brand's main color: the cover, section and closing fields, table headers, links. |
| `secondary` | color |  | The second brand color: the waves, the section slide's eyebrow, selection highlights. |
| `foreground` | color |  | Body text on content slides. |
| `background` | color |  | The content slides' paper. |
| `primary-text` | color |  | Text set on the primary field (titles on the cover, section and closing slides). |
| `primary-contrast` | color |  | The primary color where it is small text on the paper (links, note callouts); a darker primary when the primary is too light to read. |
| `accent` | color |  | The accent tab beside titles; caution and warning callouts; the base of alert text in code. |
| `highlight` | color |  | A second small-text accent on the paper: tips, examples, strings in code. |
| `muted` | color |  | Captions, footnotes, asides, block quotes and other quiet text. |
| `surface` | color |  | The pale fill behind code blocks and table bands. |
| `warning` | color |  | The bar of a caution slide; its soft fill is the caution-fill blend. |
| `dark` | color |  | The darkest field: the feature slide's bar and panel, dark slides, and code text unless code-text says otherwise. |
| `code-text` | color |  | Code text (default: the dark role; a dark livery's dark is a field, so it names a light color). |

### `blends`

Colors the engine blends from the roles, set outright. A value is a palette name or a hex.

| key | type | default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `table-rule` | color |  | The thin rule between table rows (default: 20% foreground on surface). |
| `table-band` | color |  | Every second table row's fill (default: 60% surface on the paper). |
| `caution-fill` | color |  | The soft field behind a caution slide's body (default: 18% warning on the paper). |
| `alert-text` | color |  | Warnings and errors in code (default: 72% accent on dark). |
| `rule` | color |  | Hairlines: the content title's rule and the chart grid (default: 30% foreground on surface). |

### `art`

Pictures and curves behind the fields. A path is relative to the livery.

| key | type | default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `title` | path |  | A picture covering the cover's field. |
| `section` | path |  | A picture covering section slides' field. |
| `closing` | path |  | A picture covering the closing slide's field (a band livery's default: title's). |
| `content` | path |  | A picture behind every content slide. |
| `titlegraphic` | path |  | The cover photo for decks that set none (a deck's titlegraphic: none keeps the plain cover). |
| `waves` | object |  | The brand's wave lines, drawn by the engine in the roles' colors: bands on the cover, section and closing slides, faint lines behind content slides. |

### `art.waves`

The brand's wave lines, drawn by the engine in the roles' colors: bands on the cover, section and closing slides, faint lines behind content slides.

| key | type | default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `lines` | 3 lines of 7 [x, y] points |  | Three lines from the top edge to the bottom, each two cubic curves as seven [x, y] points (start, two controls, the joint, two controls, end), fractions of the slide, y down. |
| `shift` | object |  | How far right of the drawn position each slide kind shows them, of the width. |

### `type`

Text sizes in points on the pptx.size canvas, whole or half points. A role left out is the engine's default (given here on 13.333 x 7.5 in) scaled to the canvas; subhead, table, code, caption and footnote also scale with the body.

| key | type | default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `body` | number | `16` | Body text and the first list level. |
| `subhead` | number | `20` | A ### heading inside a slide. |
| `frametitle` | number | `27` | A content slide's title. |
| `table` | number | `13` | Table text. |
| `code` | number | `11` | Code blocks. |
| `caption` | number | `11` | Figure and table captions. |
| `footnote` | number | `11` | A slide's † footnotes. |
| `title` | number | `29` | The deck's title on the cover. |
| `subtitle` | number | `20` | The cover's subtitle. |
| `date` | number | `11` | The cover's date. |
| `author` | number | `16` | The cover's author line. |
| `institute` | number | `16` | The cover's institute line. |
| `fineprint` | number | `7` | The small print under the cover's title block (e.g. a funding statement). |
| `section` | number | `40` | A section slide's heading. |
| `sectionsubtitle` | number | `20` | The paragraph under a section slide's heading. |
| `eyebrow` | number | `11` | The "SECTION n" label over a section slide's heading. |
| `closing` | number | `40` | The closing slide's headline. |
| `pagenumber` | number | `9` | The page number. |
| `footer` | number | `9` | The footer line (footer=full). |
| `levels` | list of 5 numbers | `[16, 15, 13, 12, 11]` | The five list levels, the first the body. |

### `charts`

The chart colors: where a palette for plots comes from. With none of these, the engine generates one from the brand's colors that passes the dataviz checks.

| key | type | default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `anchors` | list of color or role | `["primary", "accent", "secondary", "highlight"]` | Brand hues the categorical series must start with, in order. |
| `extended` | list of color or role |  | More brand hues to use, in order, before any are generated (default: the palette's chromatic colors). |
| `avoid` | list of objects |  | Hue ranges the generated series stay out of, each {hue, width} in degrees (OKLCH; width 30 by default). |
| `chroma` | number |  | How saturated the generated series are (OKLCH chroma; default: the brand hues', within 0.11-0.17). |
| `ramps` | map |  | A brand's published color ramps, light to dark, by name: they become color maps and steer the categorical series. |
| `maps` | map |  | More color maps, light to dark, by name, which leave the categorical series alone. |
| `sets` | object |  | A brand's published series sets by size, for plots of n series. |
| `categorical` | list of color or role |  | The series colors in order, pinned (a brand's published set); the first eight are PowerPoint's Custom Colors row. |
| `default-map` | color or role | `"primary"` | The color map heatmaps and other continuous plots use by default: a ramps or maps name, or a color, whose nearest ramp is taken. |
| `diverging` | list of color or role |  | A diverging scale, pinned: two colors are its poles, more are the whole scale. |
| `status` | object |  | The status colors, pinned. |
| `muted` | color or role |  | The "Other" series color, pinned. |
| `dark` | object |  | The same pins for dark slides; what is left out follows the light ones. |
